title: Mechanical violation auto-fixer for content-standards sweep
description:
Applies safe, rule-based corrections to every content-standards violation classified as mechanical, and confirms each fix actually resolves the flagged violation.

## Background

A prior scan enumerates every content-standards violation across the project's issues and documents and classifies each as mechanical or judgment, per the rules in `docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md`. Mechanical violations follow a single unambiguous correction: inserting a missing `[hard]`/`[aspirational]` marker with a fresh `REQ-N` id, stripping an embedded id or ordinal from a title, or inserting a missing `## Success Criteria` heading. These are safe to apply without a human decision. Judgment violations are never touched here.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: For every finding classified as `mechanical`, the fixer applies the correction to the source issue or document.
- [hard] REQ-02: Re-scanning the project after the fixer runs no longer reports any of the fixed findings as violations.
- [hard] REQ-03: The fixer makes no change to any finding classified as `judgment`, and makes no change to any issue or document with zero mechanical findings.
- [hard] REQ-04: For each fix applied, the fixer records the issue or document changed and the rule it corrected.

## Notes

A correction changes only the content the rule targets; it leaves every other part of the issue or document (other sections, unrelated criteria) unchanged.
